acceptedObligations.parentText: Validate options and platform before effects; preview performs local discovery and exits before terminal, staging or installation, with legacy/no-target refusals and unresolved remote choices.
Offline preview makes no metadata, provider, download or network availability requests and does not adopt cached metadata as authority.
Guard every alternate effect site, including staging, writes, copy, removal, extraction, clipboard, browser launch and cleanup; suppressed copy must be false.
Return no usable artifact from preview helpers and prevent expansion, copy or store fallback from consuming proposed paths.
Cover fresh and cached Chromium/Firefox, metadata/unpacked/preset sentinels, store/ask/fallback, already installed, missing preset, mixed/legacy/zero and malformed options.
Combine independent subject filesystem snapshots with effect/transport interception; separate harness logs and host startup writes from installer state.
Normal positive and NO_OPEN/NoOpen controls must still reach exact downloads, staging, configuration, clipboard and manual consumers.
Detect eager initialization, cached early return, preview copy and EXIT cleanup mutants, using the relevant cached/positive controls and excluding bootstrap failures.
Join the private staging/lifetime, normal terminal input and Windows encoding/selector interfaces without allowing preview initializer or cleanup effects.
Keep mode-specific completion honest: would/unresolved/preview-only, explicit refusal, dashboard replacement warning, and normal manual installation/import pending.
Preserve preset configuration, manual dashboard boundary, card and permissions; apply only the later outer-wrapper amendment.
Bind the delivered public script/document and generated-command source bytes to the exact reviewed target.

documentationFacts.section: README / One-line install / Offline local preview
documentationFacts.fact: DRY_RUN=1 bash ./install.sh and chosen native powershell.exe/pwsh.exe -File "./install.ps1" -DryRun perform offline local discovery and print planned actions. They do not ask questions or require terminal answers; legacy-only/no eligible/malformed options remain explicit refusals.

No writes/staging/extraction/copy/removal/cleanup, clipboard/browser/profile/extension effects, metadata/provider/download/network-availability requests or usable artifacts. Remote version/path/source choice remains unresolved; preview is not installation, staged completion or remote availability proof.

documentationFacts.section: README / NoOpen distinction and builder exposure
documentationFacts.fact: NO_OPEN=1/-NoOpen only suppress browser/open operations in normal mode. Network/download/staging/configured preset/clipboard/manual work remains. Existing builder normal command/comment points to the actual preview guidance and stays unchanged.

reuseRules: Reuse an accepted row only with unchanged relevant source bytes, interface, test inputs and native environment assumptions; bind them in a reuse manifest. A new source/tree digest alone is insufficient. Changing README does not invalidate unchanged native installer bytes.

Keep historical native execution historical. Native Linux Bash5.2.21, Windows PowerShell5.1.26100.9444 and PowerShell7.6.6 receipts are not fresh reruns or Apple proof. No disabled-builtin, PLATFORM=mac, VM, Linux/GNU utility or Windows-filesystem substitution closes an actual Apple cell.

The current 16-case public rollout and 139-file binding establish the delivered baseline. They do not establish future changed documentation, diagnostic-specific overlay/reduced-motion cases, or every backlog obligation.

If an installer/runtime/serializer changes, invalidate the affected call-chain and mutant receipts and rerun only the corresponding necessary native/consumer gates after authorization. A doc-only patch reuses unchanged parser/selector/staging/currentness interfaces.
